subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Airport and Hotel Wi-Fi Scams
description: A short lesson to help you apply Airport and Hotel Wi-Fi Scams.

hook.text: You connect to 'Free Airport WiFi.' A hacker set up that network five minutes ago.

buildup.text: Evil twin networks mimic legitimate Wi-Fi to intercept passwords, emails, and financial data.

discovery.text: Creating a fake hotspot takes minutes and costs nothing. Any smartphone can do it.

twist.text: Even HTTPS sites can be compromised if the attacker controls the network and uses SSL stripping.

climax.text: Using a VPN or mobile data is the only safe option on unfamiliar networks.

punchline.text: Free Wi-Fi is free because you're paying with your data.

quiz.question: What is an 'evil twin' Wi-Fi network?
options: A fake network mimicking a legitimate one to steal data
